answer: New identities enter a probationary haven: three established sponsors each lock a 40-unit bond, and the newcomer must pass a live pulse check every epoch, proving real work, for 6 epochs before full trading opens. A sponsor whose protege cheats loses the bond plus a 10-unit penalty, and the sponsor's quota shrinks by a delta of 25% per offense. So 100 fake identities need 300 sponsors risking 12,000 units plus 600 verified work pulses, while honest agents pay nothing beyond normal trade.
